entries.author: GitHub Copilot
entries.summary: Added classic Visual Studio solution file to fix Solution Explorer visibility
entries.rationale: Existing .slnx contained an empty <Solution /> element. Adding a .sln referencing the project enables Visual Studio to display project contents in Solution Explorer.
entries.notes: Open the new .sln file (new-code/UndercutAnalyser/UndercutAnalyser.sln) in Visual Studio to load the project and restore normal Solution Explorer behaviour.

entries.author: GitHub Copilot
entries.summary: Added NuGet.Config to set repo-local package folder and restored packages
entries.rationale: Resolve build failure caused by missing machine-specific fallback package folder during package resolution
entries.buildResult: dotnet restore/build succeeded when using repo-local packages folder
entries.notes: Created .nuget/packages and added NuGet.Config to avoid reliance on machine-specific Visual Studio fallback package folders. Subsequent CI may still need validation.
